description: This file provides a helper class for unit testing Eclipse Hono clients by creating mock objects and stubs for various components such as Vert.x contexts, Proton messaging elements, OpenTracing spans, and Hono connections.

classes.name: HonoClientUnitTestHelper
classes.description: A utility class that provides mock objects for unit testing Eclipse Hono clients, including mocked Vert.x contexts, Proton messaging components, OpenTracing spans, and Hono connections.

methods.name: mockContext
methods.description: Creates and returns a mocked Vert.x Context that immediately executes any code scheduled on it.

methods.name: mockProtonSender
methods.description: Creates and returns a mocked ProtonSender that is always open and configured with specific QoS.

methods.name: mockProtonReceiver
methods.description: Creates and returns a mocked ProtonReceiver that is always open.

methods.name: mockSpanBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a mocked OpenTracing SpanBuilder that produces a specified Span when started.

methods.name: mockHonoConnection
methods.description: Creates and returns a mocked HonoConnection configured with a Noop tracer, using default or specified client configuration properties.
